v1.1.1: add slug/displayName/summary/license frontmatter for SkillHub CLI publish; bump version to 1.1.1
v1.1.0: unify slug to aliyun-oss-static-deploy-skill (keep -skill suffix to match SkillHub/GitHub); add deploy_oss.py/build_static.py/verify_deploy.py; align SKILL.md & manifest name fields

Initial release – deploy static sites to Aliyun OSS with custom domain, HTTPS, GitHub Actions, and automated certificate renewal.

- Supports static deployment from dist/, web/, out/, or build/ folders to OSS with bucket setup, public access fixes, and proper Content-Type and caching.
- Guides through custom domain binding, HTTPS certificate issuance (incl. DNS-01 automation & CAS upload), and common issues.
- GitHub Actions auto-deploy setup with secure secrets and variable management; provides RAM policy instructions.
- Automated certificate renewal via script and compatibility with scheduled tasks.
- Includes detailed verification steps and troubleshooting for common deployment errors.
